I saw this post. Became immediately anxious and nervous that I'd jinx myself by clicking the link. Clicked the link, freaked out and left, then convinced myself that I was being dumb and had nothing to worry about, so I have come back to write this... Yes. Birthdays can be super shitty sometimes. (Refer back to paranoia about reading about bad birthdays.) I've had my fair share... more bad than good at this point, but I will say that it just makes those good birthdays that much better. The last few birthdays have been great. Nothing super unique like surprise trips around the world, but people have actually gone out of their way to make it special for me. They take me out to dinner, or make me a cake. Being 30, without family and very few friends, it really means a lot for the few that I do have to make it a point to still reach out and make the day special. Especially since I've rarely looked forward to them.

Over the years I've come to realize, and come to terms with the fact, that shitty things happening on the same date are simply coincidences. We only remember our birthdays so well because it's a holiday and we are conditioned to believe, or at least anticipate, that they'll be something spectacular, or that you'll be happy. But the truth is, the world doesn't revolve around us. The universe isn't zeroing in on us to make sure we have shitty birthdays. Sometimes people just have shitty birthdays, and unfortunately, some of those people will have even shittier birthdays than others. At the end of the day, it's just another day.

That being said, I sincerely hope that your future birthdays are brighter and far less sucky. <3 Until then, Happy Birthday and a fruitful year to you!
